title: De Giorgi Conjecture for the Allen-Cahn Equation in Dimensions 4 to 8
exact_target: In dimensions four through eight, must every bounded entire Allen–Cahn solution that is strictly monotone in one direction depend on only one linear coordinate?

sources.citation: Hardy Chan, Xavier Fernández-Real, Alessio Figalli, and Joaquim Serra, arXiv:2503.21245.
